source_notes: Harvested via Nimble map/extract on sapphirepools.co (home, about-us, pricing, faq pages). Review quotes are real Google reviews embedded directly on-site (each links out to a share.google review URL). Owner first name 'Jose' is confirmed repeatedly across the site and reviews, including the About Us testimonial that reads '...and particularly the owner - Jose'; no last name is published anywhere on-site. Searched Florida Sunbiz for a matching active LLC/Inc under 'Sapphire Pool Service' at this address/phone and found no clean match, so the surname remains unconfirmed - do not guess it. No formal 'hours of operation' are posted; FAQ states scheduling is typically within 24-48 hours, weekend visits are available at a premium, and one review notes the owner personally answering an emergency call at 7 PM on a Saturday. The site's other imagery (repeated 'Pool Guy' background graphics) reads as template/stock art and was excluded as not clearly the business's own photography.
